newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Meilin posts strong sales in Jan-Oct.
newsitem.headline: Meilin posts strong sales in Jan-Oct.

text.p: Hefei Meilin Co Ltd sold 720,000 refrigerators in the January to October period of this year, compared with 750,000 in the whole of 1995, the official Shenzhen Special Zone Daily said on Tuesday.

The newspaper said the refrigerator maker expected to have an industrial output value of 2.5 billion yuan this year. It did not give a comparative figure and company officials were not immediately available for comment.
In a trade fair in the south China city of Guangzhou last month, Meilin received purchase orders for 350,000 refrigerators worth US$42 million, the newspaper said.

Meilin said in its B share listing notice that, under Chinese accounting standards, it had unaudited net earnings of 79.02 million yuan in the first half of 1996, up from 60.24 million in the same 1995 period.
In the period, earnings per share rose to 0.46 yuan from 0.40 yuan while main operating income climbed to 824.58 million yuan from 669.15 million in the same 1995 period, Meilin said.

Meilin attributed the earnings surge to higher sales of its refrigerators. The firm, which listed 100 million B shares in Shenzhen in August, makes other appliances such as washing machines and air-conditioners.
Meilin, based in Hefei, the capital of the east China province of Anhui, has forecast net earnings of 138 million yuan for this year.
